name: Himachal Pradesh State Data Centre (SDC), Mehli
developer: Government of Himachal Pradesh - IT Department
notes: CM Virbhadra Singh inaugurated the HP State Data Centre and new IT department building at Mehli, Shimla on 4 June 2016; it was described as India's first 'green' data centre, built at a cost of Rs 58 crore to host e-governance applications (101 services via Lok Mitra Kendras, HIMSWAN connectivity). MW capacity not disclosed. The Tribune (Oct 2025) separately reports an IT park at Mehli, Shimla targeted for completion by Dec 2025, adjacent infrastructure rather than a distinct DC.

name: HPSEBL Data Centre, Vidyut Bhawan
developer: Himachal Pradesh State Electricity Board Ltd (HPSEBL)
notes: Public tender listings describe an HPSEBL Ltd data centre at Vidyut Bhawan, Shimla (AMC and onsite-support tenders), paired with a disaster recovery centre at Paonta Sahib, Sirmaur district. Small enterprise/government facility; no MW capacity published; status inferred as operational from recurring maintenance-tender activity. Evidence limited to tender aggregator snippets.

name: HPSEBL Disaster Recovery Centre, Paonta Sahib
developer: Himachal Pradesh State Electricity Board Ltd (HPSEBL)
notes: Tender listings for HPSEBL IT infrastructure reference a Disaster Recovery Centre at Paonta Sahib (Sirmaur district) supporting the HPSEBL data centre at Vidyut Bhawan, Shimla. Small DR facility; capacity unknown; evidence is tender aggregator snippets only.

name: Himachal Cyber City, Waknaghat
developer: Government of Himachal Pradesh - Digital Technologies and Governance Department
notes: CM Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu announced on 10 Oct 2025 a Cyber City at Waknaghat, Solan district over 650 bighas to house data storage, AI and other IT enterprises; detailed blueprint yet to be finalised. The adjacent Centre of Excellence at Waknaghat is under construction with an AI lab planned. HP also has a state Data Centre Policy offering capital subsidies and 10-year electricity-duty exemption (per MeitY policy roundup). No private developer or MW capacity named.
